listing.name: Dalton's Revised Arthr's Pirates but Epic 1.0.0
listing.displayName: Dalton's Revised Arthr's Pirates but Epic
listing.summary: Have you ever been playing starsector with a billion modded factions, but, much to your chagrin, you actually don't end up encountering their ships and fleets in combat very often, if ever? I certainly have had this happen to me fairly often while playing; I dont necessarily want to go to war with a faction just to see their ships and I don't really want to make my whole fleet based on said faction just to see them either. Plus pirates get kinda monotonous and boring to fight after a while.
listing.aiSummary: Replaces standard pirate fleet spawns with randomly selected faction fleets that are treated as pirates.

description: Hijacks pirate fleet generation to spawn 'pirate' versions of existing faction fleets with a configurable chance. These replacement fleets are dmodded like normal pirates and belong to the pirate faction, while special quest-related fleets remain unaffected.
